response.overview: Set in the rural village of Raurvan, where superstition and patriarchy dominate everyday life, women are often branded as “Daayan” (witches) to silence them. Kaali, a young woman who believes in education and change, begins to question these oppressive traditions. The film explores village life with raw realism. the social pressures, the fear, the rituals, and how people blindly follow age-old customs. It is a story about resistance, truth, and a woman’s fight against systemic injustice.
response.title: Kaali
